Extensive web research (Indeed, Cortera, Manta, DNB, Craft.co, GlobalData, KDP careers, ZipRecruiter, city-data) returned NO verifiable street address for a KDP / Dr Pepper Snapple distribution facility in Fontana. KDP's documented Inland Empire DSD presence shows in Riverside (Manta: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc, Riverside 92507) and Redlands, not a confirmable Fontana depot.
